figures.llm_description: Figure 3. Comparison of electronic properties of 120° 1T′/1T′ domain boundary and 1T′/1H boundary coexisting in single-layer WSe2. (a) STM image of a mixed-phase WSe2 island with a 120° 1T′/ 1T′ domain boundary (standard STM topograph).
